messages.subject: CI of means - chapter 4, exercise 5
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I have a question regarding the key of exercise (5) of chapter 4, reproduced below:

(5)   50 students took a statistics exam, the average (!) result was 77% (standard deviation 10.3). What is the 99%-confidence interval for this result?

se <- 0.103/sqrt(50)

tvalue <- qt(0.005, df=49, lower.tail=FALSE)

77-(se*tvalue) # lower limit of the 99%-confidence interval

77+(se*tvalue) # upper limit of the 99%-confidence interval

I can’t figure out why the sd to calculate the se is 0.103 and not 10.3. I could make sense of it if the mean used in the calculation for the lower and upper limits of the CI was 0.77 (since it’s a percentage), but not with 77 as is the case in the code here. Am I missing something?

Thanks in advance for any help!

Samantha
